name: William Suff (Riverside Prostitute Killer)
note: Convicted 1995 of 12 murders in Riverside County, 1986-1991.

name: Hillside Stranglers (Bianchi and Buono)
note: Strangulations of women in Los Angeles, 1977-1978; both convicted.

name: Golden State Killer, Orange County murders
note: Joseph DeAngelo bludgeoned victims in Orange County 1980-1981; pleaded guilty 2020.

name: Gary Ridgway (Green River Killer)
note: Pleaded guilty 2003 to 48 murders, most in King County 1982-1984. Used by MAP to develop its algorithm.

name: Darren Vann (Gary, Indiana)
note: Strangulations spread thinly over about 20 years; Gary was flagged by MAP's algorithm.

name: Chester Turner (Southside Slayer)
note: Convicted 2007 and 2014 of strangling 14 women in Los Angeles, 1987-1998; linked by DNA in 2003-2004.

name: Lonnie Franklin Jr. (Grim Sleeper)
note: Convicted 2016 of 10 murders of women in South Los Angeles, 1985-1988 and 2002-2007; victims shot or strangled.

name: Randy Kraft (Scorecard Killer)
note: Convicted 1989 of murdering 16 young men in Orange County, 1972-1983 (case file starts 1976). Tests male victims.

name: Andre Crawford (Chicago)
note: Convicted 2009 of 11 murders of women in Chicago's Englewood area, 1993-1999. Another serial killer, Hubert Geralds, was active in the same area.
